assessment.nobel_worthiness: Visionary, densely patterned prose in which memory, the body and dream are built into a large metaphysical architecture. Blinding (the opening volume of the Orbitor trilogy) and Solenoid are the representative works. The voice is highly distinctive and the formal ambition is sustained across volumes. The imaginative and intellectual depth is considerable. Poetry and other prose widen the range beyond the long novels.
assessment.attribution: Single-writer attribution is clear. A citation could rest on the creation of an encyclopedic, inward fictional cosmos in Romanian that renews the European visionary tradition through the body and memory. The longlist entry names fiction and poetry in Romanian.
assessment.maturity: A long, cumulative career with several major works over decades. The oeuvre looks consolidated and coherent, and there is no sign of a late decline in ambition.
uncertainties: Judgment of the prose style rests heavily on translations, and the density of the Romanian original may not carry fully into them.
Coverage of the poetry and the earlier work in translation is incomplete.
The very long, self-referential novels may limit the breadth of significance beyond readers of ambitious fiction.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Grotesque, mythic and satirical narrative forms address ideology, state violence and the costs of development. The Four Books and The Explosion Chronicles are the listed works. He has also developed an explicit poetics of 'mythorealism' in essays. The formal inventiveness is real and the moral and political stakes are carried by the fiction itself. The imaginative force is sustained across several decades.
assessment.attribution: A clear single-writer attribution. The citation scope would be a Chinese-language fictional project that uses myth and grotesque allegory to render collective trauma and modernization. Political symbolism alone is not treated as literary merit here, and the case rests on narrative form.
assessment.maturity: A deep body of work across novels, stories and essays, still developing. The late work remains formally adventurous.
uncertainties: Translation quality and selection vary, and the register of the Chinese prose is hard to judge from English or other versions.
Some works circulate under censorship constraints, so the corpus available to readers is uneven.
The political context could overshadow a purely literary reading.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Hybrid works remake the boundaries between classical scholarship, lyric, narrative and visual form. Autobiography of Red (a verse novel) and Nox (an elegy built as an object) are the listed works. The voice is distinctive, the formal and linguistic accomplishment is high, and the engagement with Greek antiquity gives intellectual depth. The work is original and widely discussed in English-language poetry.
assessment.attribution: A single writer with a coherent method of translation, essay, poetry and book-object form. A citation could name the renewal of lyric and elegiac form through classical learning and genre hybridity. The longlist classifies her under poetry, essays and drama in English.
assessment.maturity: A substantial, mature body of work over several decades. Some of it is fragmentary or occasional in form, which complicates judging sustained quality across the whole oeuvre.
uncertainties: Much of the work is bound to English-language wordplay and Greek and Latin intertexts, which may not translate well.
Some formal experiments are tied to the physical book object and may not be fully assessable in translation.
It is uncertain whether the weight of the oeuvre is greater in the major books or in the many shorter pieces.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A desert cosmology joins Tuareg experience, ecological limits and metaphysical fiction in Arabic. Gold Dust and The Bleeding of the Stone are the listed works. The imaginative world is highly distinctive and conceived over a very large body of novels. The writing makes a mythic, allegorical register carry contemporary questions of ecology and modernity. Its position in modern Arabic fiction is unusual because the Sahara is its central setting.
assessment.attribution: A single-writer attribution with a clear citation scope: a sustained mythopoetic fiction of the Sahara and Tuareg life written in Arabic. The oeuvre is large and coherent in theme.
assessment.maturity: A long career with a very extensive output. The thematic world is stable and deep, though possibly repetitive in its core motifs.
uncertainties: The Arabic prose and its Tuareg cultural references are only partly accessible in translation.
Only a portion of the very large corpus is available in translation, and the quality of translations varies.
Repetition across works may limit the sense of formal development.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Large, polyphonic narratives remake the novel through Indigenous sovereignty, oral forms and ecological time. Carpentaria and The Swan Book are the listed works. The narrative scale and voice are distinctive, and the language handles both political and mythic registers. The achievement is formally ambitious and tied to a specific community's history and storytelling.
assessment.attribution: A single writer with a clear citation scope: Indigenous Australian epic fiction that reworks English-language narrative through oral and collective forms. The listing also includes nonfiction, which broadens the contribution.
assessment.maturity: A major body of work, but a smaller novelistic corpus than several other candidates. The cumulative depth is real but concentrated in a few books.
uncertainties: The count of major novels is modest compared with other candidates, which bears on 'sustained quality'.
Some of the novels' dense, digressive structure may divide readers.
My knowledge of the later and nonfiction works is less detailed than of the two main novels.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: A radically inward fiction builds a distinctive system of landscape, memory and mental images. The Plains and Border Districts are the listed works. The voice is austere and unmistakable, and the formal control is high. The preoccupation with the mechanics of imagining and writing gives the work real intellectual depth. The scale of the achievement is intense rather than wide.
assessment.attribution: A clear single-writer attribution. A citation could name a fiction of mental landscape and the architecture of memory in English prose of great precision. It is a very personal project whose reach is mainly through its formal singularity.
assessment.maturity: A long and coherent late-career body of work that has been recognized comparatively late. The oeuvre is very consistent, with a narrow thematic range.
uncertainties: The narrow thematic and formal range raises questions about breadth of significance.
The work is deliberately self-enclosed, and its uptake outside English-language readers is less certain.
Translation coverage is limited, so impact across languages is uncertain.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: He remade Arabic poetic language through myth, fragmentation and sustained dialogue with inherited forms. Songs of Mihyar the Damascene and A Time Between Ashes and Roses are the listed works. His critical writing on Arabic poetics adds intellectual depth beyond the poems. The case for formal and linguistic achievement is strong inside Arabic poetry.
assessment.attribution: A single writer with a clear scope: modernist Arabic poetry and poetics. The longlist places him under poetry and essays in Arabic.
assessment.maturity: An exceptionally long career and a consolidated historical position. The risk is that the strongest influence belongs to earlier decades, so assessment of sustained recent quality is less clear.
uncertainties: Poetry is the genre most affected by translation loss, and the Arabic prosodic innovations are hard to judge in other languages.
Coverage of the full corpus in translation is incomplete.
Political and cultural-symbolic readings of his position could be confused with literary merit.

assessment.nobel_worthiness: Dreamlike narrative worlds destabilize ordinary psychology, space and causal storytelling. Frontier and Love in the New Millennium are the listed works. The voice is radically original within Chinese fiction and the formal commitment to the non-realist is consistent. The intellectual and imaginative interest is high, with a philosophical dimension that runs through the stories and novels.
assessment.attribution: A single-writer attribution with a clear citation scope: an uncompromising experimental fiction in Chinese. Her place in the field would be argued on formal radicalism rather than on social documentation.
assessment.maturity: A long, steady career with consistent method. Whether the many works develop or restate the same mode is hard to judge from the translated selection.
uncertainties: A limited portion of her work is available in translation, so coverage is partial.
The consistency of the experimental mode may limit perceived development.
It is hard to judge the density of the language, and the quality of the translations bears heavily on assessment.
